g.text: Concurrent motion · reproduced GIGA communication failure
Both jobs are legal members of the Axis family.
Heartbeats and ownership renewals must remain serviceable.
No HardFault observed; M4 remains alive.
A short debugger sample found command serialization active,
but does not prove that serialization caused the timeout.
Passing isolated raw / coordinated waveform captures do not
qualify this overlap. Do not claim complete application readiness.
No relaxation of heartbeat or ownership deadlines was applied.
Motor-disconnected application fixture; this is an unresolved qualification blocker.
Temporal sequence from console records; the exact blocking / scheduling mechanism is not yet established.
